incidents.name: ParaSwapRepayAdapter V3 unvalidated paraswapData
incidents.notes: swapAndRepay/_buyOnParaSwap forwarded caller-supplied paraswapData to Augustus and left the collateral-asset allowance standing, so a crafted swap payload let the attacker pull tokens users had approved to the periphery adapter.

sources.ref: onchain review: adapter 0x02e7b851... created by 0x57dc6c401819ea097db8d4b66d8e35cda0277a73 in tx 0xfebcf4a63b149c5605b46bdfe8a255c7e4435a1990ad535603bd8d75c4a63a0b (2023-07-12), unrelated to attack sender 0x6ea83f23...; no EIP-1967 Upgraded events before the incident
